args.subject: Group booking inquiry - 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am organizing a group stay at your hotel. I am writing to inquire about availability for a group of 10 people in June.

Could you please provide information on:
- Room availability for 10 people in June
- Group rates or special packages
- Any requirements or policies for group bookings
- Booking process and deposit requirements

Please let me know what options are available and any additional information I should know.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
